English:
Spawn bases and vessels using the built-in Blueprint Factory!
You can either use your own (e.g. from CREATIVE mode) or subscriptions from the (Steam) Workshop.

SAVE a blueprint
1. Point to your station or vessel and press [ALT]+[O]
2. Use the various options from the save menu, e.g. save damage, etc.

SPAWN a blueprint 
1. Select a blueprint from the list on the left and click [[Choose for Factory]].
2. Drag and drop all the materials you need into the INTAKE.  
3. Press [[START PRODUCTION]] when all requirements are met.
4. When production is complete, open the Blueprint Library again. 
5. Select your base or ship from the ��COMPLETED�� list on the left.

You will now see a blue holo preview.  
Use the [PAGE UP[/[DOWN], [HOME]/[END] and [INS]/[DEL] keys and the mouse view for positioning. Place with [LMB].

保存蓝图
1. 指向你的空间站或飞船，按[ALT]+[O]
2. 使用保存菜单中的各种选项，例如保存损坏状态等。

生成蓝图
1. 从左侧的列表中选择一个蓝图，点击[[选择用于工厂]]。
2. 将所有所需材料拖放到进料口。
3. 当所有要求满足后，按下[[开始生产]]。
4. 生产完成后，再次打开蓝图库。
5. 从左侧的“已完成”列表中选择你的基地或飞船。

现在你将看到一个蓝色的全息预览。
使用[PAGE UP[/[DOWN], [HOME]/[END]和[INS]/[DEL]]键以及鼠标视角进行定位。按[LMB]放置。
